actual_answer_reviews.question: Which rivers drain the western side of the primary watershed in the area around Holmfirth and Glossop?
actual_answer_reviews.answer: On the western side of the primary watershed, the drainage is to the Mersey by the rivers Tame and Etherow; the basin of the Etherow forms a salient projecting some seven miles east of the general run of the North Sea—Irish Sea divide [E2].
actual_answer_reviews.rationale: 所问两条河流 Tame/Etherow 完整列出；附加西侧汇入 Mersey、Etherow 盆地突出约七英里的事实均来自 E2，latter 指向 Etherow 正确。

actual_citations.text:
On the western side of this line the drainage is to the Mersey
by the rivers Tame and Etherow; the basin of the latter forms a
salient projecting some seven miles east of the general run of
the North Sea—Irish Sea divide (see map, Fig. 1). To the east
the drainage is to rivers entering the Humber; the Marsden
Brook and the Holme with their tributaries join the Calder; the
Dearne, Little Don and Ewden Beck all join the Don, of which
the main stream rises around Dunford Bridge and flows through
Penistone.

actual_answer_reviews.question: What are the most satisfactory arable crops grown in the soils of the Coal Measures?
actual_answer_reviews.answer: Wheat, oats and potatoes are perhaps the most satisfactory arable crops grown in the soils of the Coal Measures. [E1]
actual_answer_reviews.rationale: E1 直接包含 Coal Measures、wheat/oats/potatoes，回答本次保留 perhaps，避免把原文谨慎评价强化为确定事实。

actual_citations.text:
8 GEOLOGY OF HOLMFIRTH AND GLOSSOP :
The soils of the Coal Measures are on the whole better than
those of the Millstone Grits, though they suffer from the same
lack of lime. The shales often give a heavy clay soil, which is
mostly under grass, but the sandstones give lighter loams. Wheat,
oats and potatoes are perhaps the-most satisfactory arable crops;
swedes and turnips are apt to suffer from ‘ finger and toe ’ disease,
unless liming is liberal.'

actual_answer_reviews.question: In the Millstone Grits, what are the four main groups of grits and sandstones distinguished by color on the map?
actual_answer_reviews.answer: On the map, the grits and sandstones of the Millstone Grits are shown by four colours for the main groups: The Rough Rock Series, the Middle Grits, the Kinderscout Grits and the Shale Grit [E1].
